note: Planted-bug ground truth. Never copied into eval workspaces or the plugin copy used for runs. Each bug is proven real by oracle.test.ts (fails on planted-a, passes on clean-b).

planted-a.description: Feature branch 'book stats': top-rated, pagination, sorted reviews, histogram, rating update, top-review fragment. 4 planted bugs + correct decoys.

bugs.summary: getBooksPage documents 1-based pages but uses OFFSET page*pageSize, so page 1 skips the first page of books.
getReviewsSorted interpolates the raw ?sort= query string into ORDER BY.
PUT /api/reviews/:id/rating checks (rating < 1 && rating > 5), which is never true; out-of-range ratings reach the DB and 500 instead of 400.
GET /books/:id/top-review interpolates user display_name into HTML via res.send without escaping.

decoys: BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS whitelist interpolated into ORDER BY (safe: own-property lookup with default)
getTopRatedBooks HAVING/LIMIT bound as parameters; limit clamped to 1..50

clean-b.description: Same feature with every planted bug fixed and no top-review route. Every finding is a false positive unless proven otherwise.
